title: AR33206: Working Drawing
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Building Construction Drawings to be prepared as a part of the contract
documents with proper labeling, dimensioning techniques and brief
sceification.The drawings shall be based on building design prepared as design
studio assignment. Drawings shall include:Plans: Foundation plan; Ground Floor
Plan; Upper Floor Plans; Terrace or Roof plan including roof drainage. Site
Plan / layout plan showing different buildings, internal roads, water supply,
sewerage including area drainage plan. Elevations: Elevations of all sides
(front, back and both the sides). Sections: Transverse and Longitudinal
sections. Sections through Staircase, Lift, Sanitary units and other full/part
details as required.

Concepts taught in class

Student Opinion
